method: Whole2files manual reading; pinned Git bytes matched. No GDI/runtime benchmark.
findings: LRU limits1000entries and16MiB nominal bitmap bytes, evicts before insertion, touch moves existing list node front. Text keys copied into both map and list; string/container/GDI bookkeeping not part of bitmap-byte budget.

Key covers text/colors/format/cell dimensions/DPIX/HFONT handle. Font-object lifetime/handle reuse requires caller ClearCache; no generation field. Cache not internally synchronized, implying UI-thread ownership assumption.

Raster caching bypassed for disabled option, transparent background, nonzero layout, empty or oversized bitmap. CalcRect measurements cached separately by format bit, with no bitmap bytes. Selected/partially highlighted cells can request transparent fallback.

Bitmap path draws full opaque cell with current font/colors and native DrawText, then BitBlt. Failed initial compatible DC/bitmap falls back uncached DrawText. PaintCachedEntry does not check memory DC/BitBlt success.
bitmapBytes multiplies dimensions and color size in size_t without checked arithmetic. Real client geometry bounded by UI assumptions; arbitrary huge geometry and32bit overflow not runtime tested.

CreateCacheKey/CreateCachedBitmap declared noexcept despite string/make_unique allocations; allocation failure can terminate rather than fall back. Cache admission also not exception-transactional across LRU/map operations; no allocation fault injection.
Nominal budget approach is a reference idea only. No measured win or production adoption in rrrah-dedup; text renderer not duplicate comparison engine.
limits: No actual font/DPI/background correctness, GDI resource accounting, allocation faults or paired performance tests.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred.
